exposure: Sonographic estimated fetal weight growth curves
outcome: Rate of small for gestational age neonates
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy who underwent fetal biometry between 24 and 36.6 weeks' gestation and delivered at the study center between January 2010 and February 2016.
finding: Using sonographic estimated fetal weight curves to diagnose fetal growth restriction increases the sensitivity for detecting small for gestational age neonates and identifies a group of pregnancies (G2) with poor perinatal outcomes comparable to those diagnosed by birthweight curves (G3), suggesting sonographic curves are more effective for diagnosis.
gest_age: Included pregnancies underwent fetal biometry between 24 and 36.6 weeks' gestation.
